paper_title: In Situ Measurements of Dark Photon Dark Matter Using Parker Solar Probe: Going beyond the Radio Window
coupling_convention: dimensionless kinetic mixing epsilon (scaled by sqrt(rho_A'/rho_DM)=1)
notes: Paper sets new 95% C.L. upper limits on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon using in-situ Parker Solar Probe FIELDS/RFS radio data, via resonant DPDM-to-photon conversion in solar wind plasma. Mass range 3e-10 to 8e-8 eV (70 kHz - 20 MHz), with epsilon <~ 1e-14 to 1e-13. No numerical table is provided; data_points are an approximate reconstruction of the Fig. 2 exclusion envelope based on the stated endpoints and depth quoted in text/abstract (limit ~1e-13 at both mass edges, dipping to ~1e-14 near a few 1e-9 eV). The limit is quoted as epsilon*(rho_A'/rho_DM)^0.5, i.e., assumes DPDM is all of local DM (standard 0.3 GeV/cm^3 halo density implied via v0=220 km/s Maxwellian).
